title: Inginer Sisteme de Securitate - Detectie Incendiu

details.jobDescription:
• Min 3 ani experienta in sisteme de detectie si alarmare la incendiu
  • Autorizatie ARTS – Inginer Sisteme de Securitate (obligatoriu).
  • Studii superioare tehnice (electrica, electronica, automatizari sau domenii similare).
  • Permis de conducere categoria B.
  • Experienta practica in:
  • Punerea in functiune a sistemelor adresabile;
  • Configurarea centralelor de incendiu;
  • Service si mentenanta;
  • Troubleshooting si diagnosticare;
  • Interpretarea documentatiilor tehnice.Reprezinta un avantaj
  • Experienta cu platforme precum Bosch, Siemens, Esser, Schrack, Securiton, UTC/Carrier, Kentec sau Polon-Alfa;
  • Experienta in integrarea cu sisteme BMS, HVAC, control acces sau alte sisteme de securitate.
  • Vei avea un rol esential in punerea in functiune, configurarea, testarea si suportul tehnic al sistemelor de detectie si alarmare la incendiu. Vei colabora cu echipele tehnice si cu beneficiarii pentru implementarea si optimizarea solutiilor, contribuind la livrarea unor proiecte complexe si la dezvoltarea expertizei tehnice in zona Fire Safety.
  • Punerea in functiune si configurarea sistemelor de detectie si alarmare la incendiu;
  • Programarea si testarea centralelor de incendiu;
  • Diagnosticarea si solutionarea incidentelor tehnice;
  • Activitati de service si mentenanta preventiva si corectiva;
  • Analizarea documentatiilor tehnice si validarea solutiilor;
  • Suport tehnic pentru echipele interne si beneficiari;
  • Participarea la receptii, teste si puneri in functiune.
Beneficii:
  • Salariu: 8000-9000 ron net
  • Masina de serviciu
  • Tichete de vacanta
  • Asigurare de viata

SwiconGroup has been one of the leading members of the Hungarian IT arena for almost a decade since 2017 present also in Romania.

At our Budapest-based, creative company we are using industry-standard methodologies and leading-edge technologies to deliver top-notch business solutions for our clients.

Our main activities include outsourcing, headhunting, and other HR services, along with creative application development and software operation.

Our motto is innovation, novelty, and responsibility. Our wide range of services and highly trained professionals give us the opportunity to shape our solutions to fully meet the ideas and wishes of our clients.

We are proud to have leading banks, insurance, and telecommunication companies, as well as large FMCG corporations and SSCs amongst our highly prestigious partners.

SwiconGroup completed several product development projects in the past 5 years, worth 2 million euros, proving our proactive and innovative approach.

We were granted 650.000 euros of EU support for our product development projects.

Thanks to the successful operation of our three branches, we are able to optimize our resources to the maximum extent.

Our clients do take advantage of the corporate synergies based on experiences and business deals.
